We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. And when the pipeline dries out, you don't wait around: you go on the hunt for deals.

What to expect

 * Inbound demos: 8-16 qualified demo calls per day

 * Quota ownership: clear monthly and quarterly targets

 * Pipeline management: structured follow-ups and clean CRM hygiene

 * Help sharpen our sales motion as we scale fast

Who We're Looking For

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

 * Proven closing track record along a structured funnel

 * High discipline, strong ownership, and a genuine hunger to earn

 * Natural communicator and storyteller

 * Native or C2 Polish; strong English. German is a big plus

 * Ready for a paid temporary relocation (around 2 months in Vienna to soak up our culture)

 * €65.000-€80.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Unlimited budget with the right ROI

 * Relocation bonus (in case you want to stay in Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy

 * Regular team offsites

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 45 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a demo simulation

 * 30 min chat to get to know the go-to-market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

Within Erste Group Risk Management, the Market & Liquidity Risk Analytics team manages daily end-of-day market data processes. This data supports the valuation of financial instruments, the calculation of regulatory risk metrics, and risk steering across Erste Group, with a particular focus on capital markets products and their representation within valuation systems. 

This part-time role (15 hours per week) gives you valuable insight into market risk management. You will build your understanding of capital market products and the data behind them while learning from experienced colleagues.

 * Perform end-of-day quality assurance and processing of market data for pricing and risk management systems.

 * Support daily market data operations during late afternoon and evening hours to ensure timely processing.

 * Use market data terminals and processing applications to maintain reliable data quality.

 * Work with financial instrument valuation systems to support pricing and risk calculations.

 * Investigate and resolve data discrepancies to improve operational accuracy and consistency.

Your Background

 * You are currently studying Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or a related field.

 * Basic knowledge in pricing of capital market products and related market data.

 * Good communication skills in writing and verbally across all levels

 * Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken.

 * Solid IT and data management skills
